writeup.key_factor: Cleveland confirmed a bullpen game for the elimination Game 6: Shawn Armstrong opens (his third appearance in three days), ace Gavin Williams is saved for a possible Game 7, and Tanner Bibee is only a bulk follower. Tampa Bay counters with Freddy Peralta, who shut Cleveland out for six innings in Game 2 and owns a 0.79 ERA this postseason. The Rays are home (55-26 at Tropicana Field) with a 3-2 series lead and a chance to close it out tonight.
writeup.risk: Bibee is a real starter working in bulk relief — if he delivers five-plus strong innings, the bullpen discount shrinks fast. Peralta also threw in relief in Game 4, so his workload is a watch item, and his regular-season line was only average. The price already moved from -144 to -148 this morning; at -150 or worse the edge is gone and the play should be passed.
